originality.rationale: In the arXiv primary full text the exact q=2 collision fiber is not computed, although q=2 is singled out as escaping the P(3) uniqueness hypothesis. The q>3 theorem cannot imply q=2. The closest published ternary theorem was read in full and has a different radix, sharp maximum and proof. Binary alternating numeration disallows repeated exponents and non-alternating signs. Searches of indexed records and accessible historical claims found no dominating or equivalent theorem; unindexed arithmetic tables remain a realistic residual priority uncertainty.
residual_risks: A non-indexed signed-binary-digit combinatorics source or private table might imply the same exact threefold fiber formula.

value.rationale: The exact primitive threefold sum-fiber invariant addresses the low-ratio dyadic lacunary frequency support singled out by sharp Fourier extension research, where P(3) uniqueness fails. The theorem gives a sharp global collision bound eight, a unique dyadic equality family, a forbidden multiplicity and an explicit value for every frequency, providing structural data for cubic Fourier decompositions without claiming any unproved analytic extension inequality.
